task: Score five Product JSON-LD and three domain-resource report checks independently of Granite.
nonGoals: No changes to parser, prepared artifact format, front end, production, CPU cap, model timeout, or usage limits.
No secondary product-page fetch. Domain inspection is limited to robots.txt, sitemap resources, and llms.txt.

outcomes.description: Score rendered Product markup and supported product comparisons from the existing prepared artifact without AI.
outcomes.evidence: Focused scorer regression tests and replay of an unchanged retained Faherty artifact.

outcomes.description: Score robots, sitemap, and llms.txt observations independently and publish available programmatic results in the existing D1 result schema.
outcomes.evidence: Queue and D1 results when Granite is unavailable, plus bounded resource-inspection coverage.

process.description: Obtain Terra implementation and independent review, run local testing and hosted CI, and preserve production.
process.evidence: Source-bound evaluation record, independent review, and handoff.

styleEfficiency.description: Reuse the retained input reader, current result writer, source validation, support inspector and usage admission.
styleEfficiency.evidence: Scoped implementation diff and reviewer findings.

exitTest.reason: The scoring work must survive queue redelivery and an independent continuation must verify retained programmatic findings.
